dialogue.text: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了我們自然界的變化模式，包括氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
dialogue.ja: 2000年以上前、古代の中国の学者たちは自然界の変化するパターン、気候、季節の移り変わり、そして天文学を観察しました。
dialogue.local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

dialogue.text: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.zh: 學者們測量並將太陽的年度運行劃分為24個節氣，用以指導古代中國的農業。
dialogue.ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを24の節気に分け、古代中国の農業を管理するために使われました。
dialogue.local: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.en: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-4 paths, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

dialogue.text: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍然指導著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
dialogue.ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は何億もの中国人の生活と伝統を導いています。
dialogue.local: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.en: According to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.

dialogue.text: Around the 23rd of July each year, the hottest solar term arrives, the Great Heat.
dialogue.zh: 每年7月23日左右，最熱的節氣——大暑到來。
dialogue.ja: 毎年7月23日頃、最も暑い節気である大暑が訪れます。
dialogue.local: Around the 23rd of July each year, the hottest solar term arrives, the Great Heat.
dialogue.en: Around the 23rd of July each year, the hottest solar term arrives, the Great Heat.

dialogue.text: During this time, crops of the warm season enjoy their fastest period of growth.
dialogue.zh: 在這段時間，暖季作物迎來最快的生長期。
dialogue.ja: この時期、暖かい季節の作物は最も速い成長期を迎えます。
dialogue.local: During this time, crops of the warm season enjoy their fastest period of growth.
dialogue.en: During this time, crops of the warm season enjoy their fastest period of growth.

dialogue.text: Traditionally, people eat ginger and pineapples and pray for good health and blessings of prosperity.
dialogue.zh: 傳統上，人們會吃薑和鳳梨，祈求健康和平安繁榮。
dialogue.ja: 伝統的に、人々は生姜とパイナップルを食べ、健康と繁栄の祝福を祈ります。
dialogue.local: Traditionally, people eat ginger and pineapples and pray for good health and blessings of prosperity.
dialogue.en: Traditionally, people eat ginger and pineapples and pray for good health and blessings of prosperity.

dialogue.text: The Great Heat is the 12th solar term out of the 24th, it has both the longest daylight hours and the highest temperatures of the year.
dialogue.zh: 大暑是24節氣中的第12個節氣，擁有全年最長的日照時間和最高的氣溫。
dialogue.ja: 大暑は24節気の中で12番目の節気で、最も長い日照時間と最高気温を持っています。
dialogue.local: The Great Heat is the 12th solar term out of the 24th, it has both the longest daylight hours and the highest temperatures of the year.
dialogue.en: The Great Heat is the 12th solar term out of the 24th, it has both the longest daylight hours and the highest temperatures of the year.

dialogue.text: Over this intense heat, many people choose to escape to the cooler climates of the North.
dialogue.zh: 在這種酷熱中，許多人選擇逃往北方較涼爽的氣候。
dialogue.ja: この激しい暑さの中、多くの人が涼しい北の気候へ避難します。
dialogue.local: Over this intense heat, many people choose to escape to the cooler climates of the North.
dialogue.en: Over this intense heat, many people choose to escape to the cooler climates of the North.

dialogue.text: As for myself, seeking to experience the true magnitude of this solar term, I came to one of China's hottest inland cities, Chongqing, a place that Chinese people have nicknamed the furnace.
dialogue.zh: 至於我自己，為了體驗這個節氣的真實感受，我來到了中國最熱的內陸城市之一——重慶，中國人稱它為火爐。
dialogue.ja: 私自身は、この節気の真の大きさを体験するために、中国で最も暑い内陸都市の一つ、重慶に来ました。中国人はここを「かまど」と呼んでいます。
dialogue.local: As for myself, seeking to experience the true magnitude of this solar term, I came to one of China's hottest inland cities, Chongqing, a place that Chinese people have nicknamed the furnace.
dialogue.en: As for myself, seeking to experience the true magnitude of this solar term, I came to one of China's hottest inland cities, Chongqing, a place that Chinese people have nicknamed the furnace.

dialogue.text: Chongqing is a geological basin, surrounded by mountains on all sides, its terrain makes it very difficult for heat to disperse.
dialogue.zh: 重慶是一個地質盆地，四面環山，地形使熱量難以散去。
dialogue.ja: 重慶は地質学的な盆地で、四方を山に囲まれており、その地形のため熱が逃げにくいです。
dialogue.local: Chongqing is a geological basin, surrounded by mountains on all sides, its terrain makes it very difficult for heat to disperse.
dialogue.en: Chongqing is a geological basin, surrounded by mountains on all sides, its terrain makes it very difficult for heat to disperse.

dialogue.text: And as a result, the summers here are both incredibly long and intense.
dialogue.zh: 因此，這裡的夏天既漫長又炎熱。
dialogue.ja: その結果、ここでは夏が非常に長く、そして激しくなります。
dialogue.local: And as a result, the summers here are both incredibly long and intense.
dialogue.en: And as a result, the summers here are both incredibly long and intense.

dialogue.text: Chongqing's large areas of water, the air is humid too.
dialogue.zh: 重慶有大片水域，空氣也很潮濕。
dialogue.ja: 重慶には広大な水域があり、空気も湿っています。
dialogue.local: Chongqing's large areas of water, the air is humid too.
dialogue.en: Chongqing's large areas of water, the air is humid too.

dialogue.text: At the arrival of the Great Heat Solar term, the entire city turns into a steaming and sizzling sauna.
dialogue.zh: 大暑節氣到來時，整個城市變成一個蒸汽騰騰、熱氣逼人的桑拿房。
dialogue.ja: 大暑の節気が来ると、街全体が蒸し暑く、まるでサウナのようになります。
dialogue.local: At the arrival of the Great Heat Solar term, the entire city turns into a steaming and sizzling sauna.
dialogue.en: At the arrival of the Great Heat Solar term, the entire city turns into a steaming and sizzling sauna.

dialogue.text: Well, as I travel this incredible country and experience all of these amazing seasons, this has to be probably the hardest one so far.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，當我遊歷這個令人驚嘆的國家，體驗這些奇妙的季節時，這大概是迄今為止最艱難的一個季節。
dialogue.ja: この素晴らしい国を旅し、様々な季節を体験してきましたが、これが今のところ一番厳しい季節だと思います。
dialogue.local: Well, as I travel this incredible country and experience all of these amazing seasons, this has to be probably the hardest one so far.
dialogue.en: Well, as I travel this incredible country and experience all of these amazing seasons, this has to be probably the hardest one so far.

dialogue.text: Not only is the heat that makes the city hard, but it is also all of these hills and mountains that make it almost impossible to build.
dialogue.zh: 不僅是炎熱讓這座城市難以忍受，還有這些山丘和山脈，使得建設幾乎不可能。
dialogue.ja: この街が厳しいのは暑さだけでなく、山や丘が多くて建設がほとんど不可能なこともあります。
dialogue.local: Not only is the heat that makes the city hard, but it is also all of these hills and mountains that make it almost impossible to build.
dialogue.en: Not only is the heat that makes the city hard, but it is also all of these hills and mountains that make it almost impossible to build.

dialogue.text: Now 30 years ago, what's behind me here was those old stilt buildings, but now it is transformed into this incredible megatropolis of 30 million people, which is hard to comprehend.
dialogue.zh: 30年前，我身後還是那些老舊的吊腳樓，但現在已經變成了這個擁有三千萬人口的巨大都市，令人難以想像。
dialogue.ja: 30年前、私の後ろには古い高床式の建物がありましたが、今では3000万人の巨大都市に変貌し、想像し難いです。
dialogue.local: Now 30 years ago, what's behind me here was those old stilt buildings, but now it is transformed into this incredible megatropolis of 30 million people, which is hard to comprehend.
dialogue.en: Now 30 years ago, what's behind me here was those old stilt buildings, but now it is transformed into this incredible megatropolis of 30 million people, which is hard to comprehend.

dialogue.text: And that has all come from the hard work and sweat and determination of the incredible people of Chongqing.
dialogue.zh: 這一切都來自重慶人民的辛勤工作、汗水和決心。
dialogue.ja: それはすべて、重慶の素晴らしい人々の努力と汗と決意から生まれました。
dialogue.local: And that has all come from the hard work and sweat and determination of the incredible people of Chongqing.
dialogue.en: And that has all come from the hard work and sweat and determination of the incredible people of Chongqing.

dialogue.text: On the streets of Chongqing, something immediately caught my attention.
dialogue.zh: 在重慶的街頭，有件事立刻吸引了我的注意。
dialogue.ja: 重慶の街で、すぐに私の注意を引くものがありました。
dialogue.local: On the streets of Chongqing, something immediately caught my attention.
dialogue.en: On the streets of Chongqing, something immediately caught my attention.

dialogue.text: The people of Chongqing call them bang bang, meaning quite literally bamboo pole carriers.
dialogue.zh: 重慶人稱他們為「棒棒」，字面意思是竹竿挑夫。
dialogue.ja: 重慶の人々は彼らを「棒棒」と呼び、文字通り竹の棒を担ぐ人たちを意味します。
dialogue.local: The people of Chongqing call them bang bang, meaning quite literally bamboo pole carriers.
dialogue.en: The people of Chongqing call them bang bang, meaning quite literally bamboo pole carriers.

dialogue.text: In Chongqing, the Yangtze and the Zhaoling rivers meet, ever since ancient times has been one of China's most important inland trade ports.
dialogue.zh: 在重慶，長江和朝靈江交匯，自古以來就是中國最重要的內陸貿易港口之一。
dialogue.ja: 重慶では長江と朝靈江が合流し、古くから中国で最も重要な内陸貿易港の一つでした。
dialogue.local: In Chongqing, the Yangtze and the Zhaoling rivers meet, ever since ancient times has been one of China's most important inland trade ports.
dialogue.en: In Chongqing, the Yangtze and the Zhaoling rivers meet, ever since ancient times has been one of China's most important inland trade ports.

dialogue.text: As the entire city is built on mountainous terrain, leaving the house often means climbing hills.
dialogue.zh: 由於整個城市建在山地，出門常常意味著要爬坡。
dialogue.ja: 街全体が山地に建てられているため、家を出るときはよく坂を登らなければなりません。
dialogue.local: As the entire city is built on mountainous terrain, leaving the house often means climbing hills.
dialogue.en: As the entire city is built on mountainous terrain, leaving the house often means climbing hills.

dialogue.text: Trade products and ordinary household merchandise will require a considerable amount of labour to carry, and with this, the bang bang, wielding a metal on bamboo shoulder pole was created.
dialogue.zh: 貿易商品和日常用品需要大量人力搬運，因此出現了用金屬掛在竹肩杆上的棒棒工人。
dialogue.ja: 貿易品や日用品は多くの労力を要するため、竹の肩棒に金属を付けた棒棒が生まれました。
dialogue.local: Trade products and ordinary household merchandise will require a considerable amount of labour to carry, and with this, the bang bang, wielding a metal on bamboo shoulder pole was created.
dialogue.en: Trade products and ordinary household merchandise will require a considerable amount of labour to carry, and with this, the bang bang, wielding a metal on bamboo shoulder pole was created.

dialogue.text: Chongqing people have long been accustomed to this style of living.
dialogue.zh: 重慶人早已習慣這種生活方式。
dialogue.ja: 重慶の人々は長い間この生活様式に慣れ親しんでいます。
dialogue.local: Chongqing people have long been accustomed to this style of living.
dialogue.en: Chongqing people have long been accustomed to this style of living.

dialogue.text: From furniture to household appliances to groceries, if you cannot do it, you only need to call bang bang.
dialogue.zh: 從家具到家電再到雜貨，如果你做不了，只需叫棒棒來幫忙。
dialogue.ja: 家具から家電、食料品まで、できなければ棒棒を呼べばいいのです。
dialogue.local: From furniture to household appliances to groceries, if you cannot do it, you only need to call bang bang.
dialogue.en: From furniture to household appliances to groceries, if you cannot do it, you only need to call bang bang.

dialogue.text: And a porter will come to help immediately.
dialogue.zh: 搬運工會立刻來幫忙。
dialogue.ja: すると運び手がすぐに助けに来ます。
dialogue.local: And a porter will come to help immediately.
dialogue.en: And a porter will come to help immediately.

dialogue.text: It is said at its peak, the city once held 400,000 bang bang workers.
dialogue.zh: 據說在鼎盛時期，這座城市曾有40萬名棒棒工人。
dialogue.ja: 最盛期には、この街に40万人の棒棒労働者がいたと言われています。
dialogue.local: It is said at its peak, the city once held 400,000 bang bang workers.
dialogue.en: It is said at its peak, the city once held 400,000 bang bang workers.

dialogue.text: Today, following the city's development, convenient public facilities are now widespread.
dialogue.zh: 如今，隨著城市發展，便利的公共設施已廣泛普及。
dialogue.ja: 今日では、都市の発展に伴い、便利な公共施設が広く普及しています。
dialogue.local: Today, following the city's development, convenient public facilities are now widespread.
dialogue.en: Today, following the city's development, convenient public facilities are now widespread.

dialogue.text: Like this escalator, stretching to 112 metres in length, the longest in Chongqing.
dialogue.zh: 例如這條長達112米的手扶梯，是重慶最長的。
dialogue.ja: 例えば、この112メートルのエスカレーターは重慶で最も長いものです。
dialogue.local: Like this escalator, stretching to 112 metres in length, the longest in Chongqing.
dialogue.en: Like this escalator, stretching to 112 metres in length, the longest in Chongqing.

dialogue.text: Even the mountainous city of Chongqing has become much easier than before.
dialogue.zh: 即使是多山的重慶市，也比以前方便多了。
dialogue.ja: 山が多い重慶の街も以前よりずっと便利になりました。
dialogue.local: Even the mountainous city of Chongqing has become much easier than before.
dialogue.en: Even the mountainous city of Chongqing has become much easier than before.

dialogue.text: And so, bang bang workers began to decline, although they have not yet completely disappeared.
dialogue.zh: 因此，棒棒工人開始減少，雖然尚未完全消失。
dialogue.ja: そのため、棒棒労働者は減少し始めましたが、まだ完全には消えていません。
dialogue.local: And so, bang bang workers began to decline, although they have not yet completely disappeared.
dialogue.en: And so, bang bang workers began to decline, although they have not yet completely disappeared.

dialogue.text: Relying on a bamboo pole for a living is a hard life, but is also genuinely liberating, and it reflects the wild and unyielding character of the Chongqing people.
dialogue.zh: 靠竹竿謀生是艱難的生活，但也是真正自由的，反映了重慶人野性且堅韌的性格。
dialogue.ja: 竹の棒に頼る生活は厳しいですが、本当に自由であり、重慶の人々の野生的で不屈の性格を表しています。
dialogue.local: Relying on a bamboo pole for a living is a hard life, but is also genuinely liberating, and it reflects the wild and unyielding character of the Chongqing people.
dialogue.en: Relying on a bamboo pole for a living is a hard life, but is also genuinely liberating, and it reflects the wild and unyielding character of the Chongqing people.

dialogue.text: In the sweltering temperatures of the Great Heat Solar term, cold noodles are probably the most appropriate meal to have.
dialogue.zh: 在大暑節氣的酷熱中，冷麵可能是最合適的餐點。
dialogue.ja: 大暑の蒸し暑い気温の中で、冷たい麺はおそらく最適な食事です。
dialogue.local: In the sweltering temperatures of the Great Heat Solar term, cold noodles are probably the most appropriate meal to have.
dialogue.en: In the sweltering temperatures of the Great Heat Solar term, cold noodles are probably the most appropriate meal to have.

dialogue.text: When noodles are rinsed under cold water after boiling, then mixed with vegetable oil and left to cool a bit more.
dialogue.zh: 麵條煮熟後用冷水沖洗，再拌入植物油並稍微冷卻。
dialogue.ja: 麺は茹でた後に冷水で洗い、植物油と混ぜて少し冷まします。
dialogue.local: When noodles are rinsed under cold water after boiling, then mixed with vegetable oil and left to cool a bit more.
dialogue.en: When noodles are rinsed under cold water after boiling, then mixed with vegetable oil and left to cool a bit more.

dialogue.text: Before eating, ginger and garlic sauce are added with citron pepper oil.
dialogue.zh: 吃之前加入薑蒜醬和香橙辣椒油。
dialogue.ja: 食べる前に、生姜とニンニクのソース、そしてシトロンペッパーオイルを加えます。
dialogue.local: Before eating, ginger and garlic sauce are added with citron pepper oil.
dialogue.en: Before eating, ginger and garlic sauce are added with citron pepper oil.

dialogue.text: It looks simple, but it's spicy, cold and refreshing.
dialogue.zh: 看起來簡單，但味道辛辣、冰涼且清爽。
dialogue.ja: 見た目はシンプルですが、辛くて冷たくてさっぱりしています。
dialogue.local: It looks simple, but it's spicy, cold and refreshing.
dialogue.en: It looks simple, but it's spicy, cold and refreshing.

dialogue.text: The afternoon sun is the most relentless, even with shoes it burns the feet.
dialogue.zh: 午後的陽光最為猛烈，穿著鞋子也會燙腳。
dialogue.ja: 午後の日差しは容赦なく、靴を履いていても足が焼けるようです。
dialogue.local: The afternoon sun is the most relentless, even with shoes it burns the feet.
dialogue.en: The afternoon sun is the most relentless, even with shoes it burns the feet.

dialogue.text: When I used to live in England, I thought 30 degrees Celsius in the summer was hot.
dialogue.zh: 我以前住在英國時，認為夏天30度已經很熱了。
dialogue.ja: イギリスに住んでいた時、夏の30度は暑いと思っていました。
dialogue.local: When I used to live in England, I thought 30 degrees Celsius in the summer was hot.
dialogue.en: When I used to live in England, I thought 30 degrees Celsius in the summer was hot.

dialogue.text: Here it feels more like 40 or even 50 degrees Celsius.
dialogue.zh: 但這裡感覺更像是40甚至50度。
dialogue.ja: ここでは40度、あるいは50度にも感じられます。
dialogue.local: Here it feels more like 40 or even 50 degrees Celsius.
dialogue.en: Here it feels more like 40 or even 50 degrees Celsius.

dialogue.text: I'm really looking forward to getting a nice coffee and sneaking away to somewhere with air conditioning.
dialogue.zh: 我非常期待喝杯好咖啡，偷偷溜到有冷氣的地方去。
dialogue.ja: 美味しいコーヒーを飲んで、こっそりエアコンのある場所に行くのを楽しみにしています。
dialogue.local: I'm really looking forward to getting a nice coffee and sneaking away to somewhere with air conditioning.
dialogue.en: I'm really looking forward to getting a nice coffee and sneaking away to somewhere with air conditioning.

dialogue.text: However, bang bang workers spend any time they have, calling off in public spaces by the street sign.
dialogue.zh: 然而，棒棒工人會利用任何空閒時間，在街邊公共場所等待工作。
dialogue.ja: しかし、棒棒労働者は空いた時間を使って、街の看板のそばの公共スペースで仕事の依頼を待っています。
dialogue.local: However, bang bang workers spend any time they have, calling off in public spaces by the street sign.
dialogue.en: However, bang bang workers spend any time they have, calling off in public spaces by the street sign.

dialogue.text: These were built into the mountains during the Second World War, serving as shelters in the event of an air strike.
dialogue.zh: 這些建築是在二戰期間建於山中，作為空襲時的避難所。
dialogue.ja: これらは第二次世界大戦中に山に建てられ、空襲時の避難所として使われました。
dialogue.local: These were built into the mountains during the Second World War, serving as shelters in the event of an air strike.
dialogue.en: These were built into the mountains during the Second World War, serving as shelters in the event of an air strike.

dialogue.text: Today, it has been refurbished into a natural calling spot for the public, yet in order to adapt to the extreme temperatures of the summer months, Chongqing people's ingenious ideas and building designs do not end here.
dialogue.zh: 如今，它已被改造為公共的自然避暑地，但為了適應夏季極端高溫，重慶人的巧思和建築設計並未止步於此。
dialogue.ja: 現在は公共の自然な避暑地として改修されていますが、夏の極端な気温に適応するために、重慶の人々の建築デザインの工夫はここで終わりません。
dialogue.local: Today, it has been refurbished into a natural calling spot for the public, yet in order to adapt to the extreme temperatures of the summer months, Chongqing people's ingenious ideas and building designs do not end here.
dialogue.en: Today, it has been refurbished into a natural calling spot for the public, yet in order to adapt to the extreme temperatures of the summer months, Chongqing people's ingenious ideas and building designs do not end here.

dialogue.text: After the architecture of Chongqing University is a researcher in the field of mountain region settlements in Chongqing and is also a specialist in modern architecture design.
dialogue.zh: 重慶大學建築系有一位研究重慶山區聚落的學者，同時也是現代建築設計專家。
dialogue.ja: 重慶大学の建築学部には、重慶の山岳地域の集落を研究し、現代建築設計の専門家でもある研究者がいます。
dialogue.local: After the architecture of Chongqing University is a researcher in the field of mountain region settlements in Chongqing and is also a specialist in modern architecture design.
dialogue.en: After the architecture of Chongqing University is a researcher in the field of mountain region settlements in Chongqing and is also a specialist in modern architecture design.

dialogue.text: He has an extensive understanding of Chongqing's peculiar mountain region architecture.
dialogue.zh: 他對重慶獨特的山區建築有深入的了解。
dialogue.ja: 彼は重慶の独特な山岳地域の建築について深い理解を持っています。
dialogue.local: He has an extensive understanding of Chongqing's peculiar mountain region architecture.
dialogue.en: He has an extensive understanding of Chongqing's peculiar mountain region architecture.

dialogue.text: Because of this, most traditional buildings are constructed with bamboo and are not easy to preserve.
dialogue.zh: 因此，大多數傳統建築使用竹子建造，且不易保存。
dialogue.ja: そのため、ほとんどの伝統的な建物は竹で作られており、保存が難しいです。
dialogue.local: Because of this, most traditional buildings are constructed with bamboo and are not easy to preserve.
dialogue.en: Because of this, most traditional buildings are constructed with bamboo and are not easy to preserve.

dialogue.text: The modernization of urban cities has not helped either.
dialogue.zh: 城市現代化也沒有幫助保存這些建築。
dialogue.ja: 都市の近代化もこれらの建物の保存には役立っていません。
dialogue.local: The modernization of urban cities has not helped either.
dialogue.en: The modernization of urban cities has not helped either.

dialogue.text: Much of the architecture in Professor Boyang's paintings have now ceased to exist.
dialogue.zh: 博陽教授畫中的許多建築如今已不復存在。
dialogue.ja: 博陽教授の絵に描かれた多くの建築は今では存在しなくなりました。
dialogue.local: Much of the architecture in Professor Boyang's paintings have now ceased to exist.
dialogue.en: Much of the architecture in Professor Boyang's paintings have now ceased to exist.

dialogue.text: Because of my inquisitiveness, as well as wanting to escape from the burning heat of the city, Professor Boyang offered to take me to a historical town an hour away from the city centre.
dialogue.zh: 出於好奇心以及想逃離城市的酷熱，博陽教授提議帶我去一個距市中心一小時車程的歷史古鎮。
dialogue.ja: 好奇心と都市の暑さから逃れたい気持ちから、博陽教授は市中心から1時間の歴史的な町へ案内してくれました。
dialogue.local: Because of my inquisitiveness, as well as wanting to escape from the burning heat of the city, Professor Boyang offered to take me to a historical town an hour away from the city centre.
dialogue.en: Because of my inquisitiveness, as well as wanting to escape from the burning heat of the city, Professor Boyang offered to take me to a historical town an hour away from the city centre.

dialogue.text: If we're lucky, we might find traces of the traditional stilt houses.
dialogue.zh: 如果幸運的話，我們可能會找到傳統吊腳樓的痕跡。
dialogue.ja: 運が良ければ、伝統的な高床式住宅の跡を見つけられるかもしれません。
dialogue.local: If we're lucky, we might find traces of the traditional stilt houses.
dialogue.en: If we're lucky, we might find traces of the traditional stilt houses.

dialogue.text: Living in Chongqing's uneven mountainous terrain is not easy.
dialogue.zh: 生活在重慶崎嶇的山地地形並不容易。
dialogue.ja: 重慶の不均一な山岳地帯での生活は簡単ではありません。
dialogue.local: Living in Chongqing's uneven mountainous terrain is not easy.
dialogue.en: Living in Chongqing's uneven mountainous terrain is not easy.

dialogue.text: The people here have always struggled for a little more living space.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的人們一直在為多爭取一點生活空間而努力。
dialogue.ja: ここに住む人々は、少しでも多くの生活空間を求めて常に奮闘しています。
dialogue.local: The people here have always struggled for a little more living space.
dialogue.en: The people here have always struggled for a little more living space.

dialogue.text: Beneath my feet is the path that locals call the stairway of love.
dialogue.zh: 我腳下的這條路是當地人稱為愛情階梯的路。
dialogue.ja: 私の足元にある道は、地元の人々が「愛の階段」と呼んでいます。
dialogue.local: Beneath my feet is the path that locals call the stairway of love.
dialogue.en: Beneath my feet is the path that locals call the stairway of love.

dialogue.text: It is perhaps the most romantic image of the persistence and unwavering character of the Chongqing people.
dialogue.zh: 這或許是重慶人堅持不懈和堅韌性格最浪漫的象徵。
dialogue.ja: それはおそらく、重慶の人々の粘り強さと揺るぎない性格の最もロマンチックな象徴です。
dialogue.local: It is perhaps the most romantic image of the persistence and unwavering character of the Chongqing people.
dialogue.en: It is perhaps the most romantic image of the persistence and unwavering character of the Chongqing people.

dialogue.text: Even though the bamboo forests offer shade, the ancient town is not exactly cool, but it's a lot more manageable than in the city.
dialogue.zh: 雖然竹林提供了遮蔭，古鎮並不算涼爽，但比城市裡好多了。
dialogue.ja: 竹林が日陰を作ってくれますが、古い町は涼しいとは言えません。しかし、都市よりはずっと過ごしやすいです。
dialogue.local: Even though the bamboo forests offer shade, the ancient town is not exactly cool, but it's a lot more manageable than in the city.
dialogue.en: Even though the bamboo forests offer shade, the ancient town is not exactly cool, but it's a lot more manageable than in the city.

dialogue.text: We took a casual stroll and came upon an open area of water.
dialogue.zh: 我們隨意散步，來到一處開闊的水域。
dialogue.ja: 私たちは気ままに散歩し、開けた水辺に出ました。
dialogue.local: We took a casual stroll and came upon an open area of water.
dialogue.en: We took a casual stroll and came upon an open area of water.

dialogue.text: It's not quite how I imagined a bamboo house to look like, but it matched Professor Boyang's description of a traditional stilt house structure.
dialogue.zh: 這與我想像中的竹屋不太一樣，但符合博陽教授對傳統吊腳樓結構的描述。
dialogue.ja: 竹の家がこういうものだとは想像していませんでしたが、博陽教授の伝統的な高床式住宅の説明に合っていました。
dialogue.local: It's not quite how I imagined a bamboo house to look like, but it matched Professor Boyang's description of a traditional stilt house structure.
dialogue.en: It's not quite how I imagined a bamboo house to look like, but it matched Professor Boyang's description of a traditional stilt house structure.

dialogue.text: The principal room is built on the ground. The wing rooms are connected to the main room and has one side resting on the hillside.
dialogue.zh: 主房建在地面上，側房與主房相連，一側依靠山坡。
dialogue.ja: 主な部屋は地面に建てられ、側室は主室に繋がっていて、一方は山の斜面に接しています。
dialogue.local: The principal room is built on the ground. The wing rooms are connected to the main room and has one side resting on the hillside.
dialogue.en: The principal room is built on the ground. The wing rooms are connected to the main room and has one side resting on the hillside.

dialogue.text: Its other three sides are suspended above ground by stilts.
dialogue.zh: 另外三面則由柱子支撐懸空於地面之上。
dialogue.ja: 残りの三方は高床式の柱で地面から浮いています。
dialogue.local: Its other three sides are suspended above ground by stilts.
dialogue.en: Its other three sides are suspended above ground by stilts.

dialogue.text: Resting beside mountains and suspended above waters, this type of building has endured thousands of years of Chinese history.
dialogue.zh: 這種建築依山傍水，歷經千年中國歷史的洗禮。
dialogue.ja: 山のそばにあり、水の上に浮かぶこの建物は、何千年もの中国の歴史を耐えてきました。
dialogue.local: Resting beside mountains and suspended above waters, this type of building has endured thousands of years of Chinese history.
dialogue.en: Resting beside mountains and suspended above waters, this type of building has endured thousands of years of Chinese history.

dialogue.text: This area of buildings beside the mountain was once a tobacco marketplace.
dialogue.zh: 這片山邊的建築區曾是煙草市場。
dialogue.ja: この山のそばの建物群はかつてタバコの市場でした。
dialogue.local: This area of buildings beside the mountain was once a tobacco marketplace.
dialogue.en: This area of buildings beside the mountain was once a tobacco marketplace.

dialogue.text: Today, it is a residential area designed to keep cool during the summer.
dialogue.zh: 如今，這裡是為夏季避暑而設計的住宅區。
dialogue.ja: 現在は夏の暑さをしのぐための住宅地となっています。
dialogue.local: Today, it is a residential area designed to keep cool during the summer.
dialogue.en: Today, it is a residential area designed to keep cool during the summer.

dialogue.text: In periods with no air conditioning, these hand-woven bamboo fans are Chongqing people's most valuable source of relief against the summer heat.
dialogue.zh: 在沒有空調的時候，這些手工編織的竹扇是重慶人抵抗夏季炎熱最寶貴的工具。
dialogue.ja: エアコンがない時期には、これらの手織りの竹製扇子が重慶の人々にとって夏の暑さを和らげる最も貴重な道具です。
dialogue.local: In periods with no air conditioning, these hand-woven bamboo fans are Chongqing people's most valuable source of relief against the summer heat.
dialogue.en: In periods with no air conditioning, these hand-woven bamboo fans are Chongqing people's most valuable source of relief against the summer heat.

dialogue.text: Despite bamboo buildings being extremely difficult to preserve, this ancient town has nonetheless managed to retain buildings that are hundreds of years old.
dialogue.zh: 儘管竹製建築極難保存，這座古鎮仍保留了數百年歷史的建築。
dialogue.ja: 竹の建物は保存が非常に難しいにもかかわらず、この古い町は何百年も前の建物を維持しています。
dialogue.local: Despite bamboo buildings being extremely difficult to preserve, this ancient town has nonetheless managed to retain buildings that are hundreds of years old.
dialogue.en: Despite bamboo buildings being extremely difficult to preserve, this ancient town has nonetheless managed to retain buildings that are hundreds of years old.

dialogue.text: In the contemporary world, the hilly terrain of the densely populated and bustling city of Chongqing is seen as a valuable resource.
dialogue.zh: 在當代，人口稠密且繁忙的重慶市丘陵地形被視為寶貴資源。
dialogue.ja: 現代では、人口密集で賑やかな重慶の丘陵地形は貴重な資源と見なされています。
dialogue.local: In the contemporary world, the hilly terrain of the densely populated and bustling city of Chongqing is seen as a valuable resource.
dialogue.en: In the contemporary world, the hilly terrain of the densely populated and bustling city of Chongqing is seen as a valuable resource.

dialogue.text: Its unique geography and climate have pushed architects to the limits of imagination.
dialogue.zh: 其獨特的地理和氣候推動建築師發揮極限想像力。
dialogue.ja: その独特な地理と気候は建築家の想像力の限界を押し広げました。
dialogue.local: Its unique geography and climate have pushed architects to the limits of imagination.
dialogue.en: Its unique geography and climate have pushed architects to the limits of imagination.

dialogue.text: Combining architecture with the natural environment, they have created a truly unique Chongqing style of architecture.
dialogue.zh: 結合建築與自然環境，他們創造了真正獨特的重慶建築風格。
dialogue.ja: 建築と自然環境を融合させ、彼らは本当に独特な重慶スタイルの建築を生み出しました。
dialogue.local: Combining architecture with the natural environment, they have created a truly unique Chongqing style of architecture.
dialogue.en: Combining architecture with the natural environment, they have created a truly unique Chongqing style of architecture.

dialogue.text: Chongqing people of all Chinese people love chili the most.
dialogue.zh: 在所有中國人中，重慶人最愛辣椒。
dialogue.ja: 中国の中でも重慶の人々は唐辛子を最も愛しています。
dialogue.local: Chongqing people of all Chinese people love chili the most.
dialogue.en: Chongqing people of all Chinese people love chili the most.

dialogue.text: Even in the melting heat of the great heat solar term, they refuse to be parted from their red chili peppers.
dialogue.zh: 即使在大暑的酷熱中，他們也不願離開紅辣椒。
dialogue.ja: 大暑の猛暑の中でも、彼らは赤い唐辛子を手放しません。
dialogue.local: Even in the melting heat of the great heat solar term, they refuse to be parted from their red chili peppers.
dialogue.en: Even in the melting heat of the great heat solar term, they refuse to be parted from their red chili peppers.

dialogue.text: Hot pots with chilies as their main ingredient are of course Chongqing's most popular and most welcomed speciality.
dialogue.zh: 以辣椒為主料的火鍋當然是重慶最受歡迎的特色菜。
dialogue.ja: 唐辛子を主な材料とした火鍋は、もちろん重慶で最も人気があり歓迎される名物料理です。
dialogue.local: Hot pots with chilies as their main ingredient are of course Chongqing's most popular and most welcomed speciality.
dialogue.en: Hot pots with chilies as their main ingredient are of course Chongqing's most popular and most welcomed speciality.

dialogue.text: Chongqing people believe that the great heat solar term is the perfect time to enjoy this spicy cuisine.
dialogue.zh: 重慶人相信大暑節氣是享用這種辣味料理的最佳時機。
dialogue.ja: 重慶の人々は大暑の節気がこの辛い料理を楽しむのに最適な時期だと信じています。
dialogue.local: Chongqing people believe that the great heat solar term is the perfect time to enjoy this spicy cuisine.
dialogue.en: Chongqing people believe that the great heat solar term is the perfect time to enjoy this spicy cuisine.

dialogue.text: With hot mouth watering chilies and soup steaming up in the air, all in the lively company of friends around me, I could feel the beads of sweat trickling down my skin.
dialogue.zh: 熱辣的辣椒和湯氣蒸騰，周圍朋友熱鬧相伴，我感受到汗珠從皮膚滑落。
dialogue.ja: 熱くてよだれが出そうな唐辛子と湯気が空中に立ち上り、友人たちと賑やかに囲みながら、汗が肌を伝って流れるのを感じました。
dialogue.local: With hot mouth watering chilies and soup steaming up in the air, all in the lively company of friends around me, I could feel the beads of sweat trickling down my skin.
dialogue.en: With hot mouth watering chilies and soup steaming up in the air, all in the lively company of friends around me, I could feel the beads of sweat trickling down my skin.

dialogue.text: The frantic buzz of the day fades away, at least for me, this is truly one of the most pleasant experiences of the great heat solar term.
dialogue.zh: 白天的喧囂漸漸消退，至少對我來說，這真是大暑節氣中最愉快的體驗之一。
dialogue.ja: 一日の慌ただしさが消え去り、少なくとも私にとっては、これは大暑の節気の中で最も心地よい体験の一つです。
dialogue.local: The frantic buzz of the day fades away, at least for me, this is truly one of the most pleasant experiences of the great heat solar term.
dialogue.en: The frantic buzz of the day fades away, at least for me, this is truly one of the most pleasant experiences of the great heat solar term.

dialogue.text: Under the cover of night, I was finally able to escape the great heat of Chongqing.
dialogue.zh: 夜幕降臨，我終於能逃離重慶的大暑酷熱。
dialogue.ja: 夜の帳が下りて、私はついに重慶の大暑の暑さから逃れることができました。
dialogue.local: Under the cover of night, I was finally able to escape the great heat of Chongqing.
dialogue.en: Under the cover of night, I was finally able to escape the great heat of Chongqing.

dialogue.text: Millenniums have passed by, our environments and lifestyles have experienced incredible transformations.
dialogue.zh: 千年流逝，我們的環境和生活方式經歷了驚人的變化。
dialogue.ja: 何千年もの時が過ぎ、私たちの環境と生活様式は驚くべき変化を遂げました。
dialogue.local: Millenniums have passed by, our environments and lifestyles have experienced incredible transformations.
dialogue.en: Millenniums have passed by, our environments and lifestyles have experienced incredible transformations.

dialogue.text: But what has remained unchanged is the continuous turning of the solar terms and the determination of humankind throughout hundreds of thousands of years to adapt and flourish in nature's challenges.
dialogue.zh: 但不變的是節氣的持續輪轉，以及人類數十萬年來適應並在自然挑戰中茁壯的決心。
dialogue.ja: しかし変わらないのは、節気の絶え間ない巡りと、何十万年もの間、人類が自然の試練に適応し繁栄しようとする決意です。
dialogue.local: But what has remained unchanged is the continuous turning of the solar terms and the determination of humankind throughout hundreds of thousands of years to adapt and flourish in nature's challenges.
dialogue.en: But what has remained unchanged is the continuous turning of the solar terms and the determination of humankind throughout hundreds of thousands of years to adapt and flourish in nature's challenges.
